name: vision-frames-v1
description: Vision Frames v1 - identity-first still image generation engine

scripts.check:import: node -e "const vf = require('./'); if (typeof vf.VisionFramesEngine !== 'function') { process.exit(1); } console.log('package import ok');"
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test -- --runInBand && npm run lint && npm run check:import && npm run smoke:mock && npm run smoke:board
scripts.smoke:board: node dist/runner.js --mock --board 7 --scenario partial --concurrency 1 --identity "calm, grounded" --place "a quiet street at dusk" --out out/smoke-board
